yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Only August is independently spoken (t01). The year and absolute departure/arrival days come from YAML; sailing-day numbers and two completed canal overnights come from the transcript.
yamlCheck.explanation: Departure day, next evening, fifth and roughly eighth sailing days, then two overnight transitions are established. The final four-ish-day sea leg and half-day upriver leg are approximate and do not settle an exact total. They can fit the YAML span; treating four-ish as exactly four would instead place arrival about a day later. No missing day is supplied from drEnd.
